messages:
sasha: FYI — scheduling a staggered shard rollout tonight 02:00 UTC for kernel v2.14-q (matmul optim + fp4 packing). Deploybot will do 6 shard buckets with drain windows. Aim: low-risk, regional stagger, quick rollback criteria.

deploybot: Scheduled rollout: kernel-v2.14-q -> pools: engine-shard-{1..6}. Buckets: 1,2,3,4,5,6 spaced 10m apart. Canary on bucket 1 (1% traffic) for 30m then ramp. Sticky-pin support: enabled. See deploy ID: deploy-4001239876.

liam: Quick Q — what sticky-pin TTL are we using? We should pin legacy-abi for at least 1h after each shard finishes so failing callers get consistent behavior.

anya: Also need a smoke checklist attached to release notes. Minimal smoke commands:```bash
# run generation smoke
curl -s -X POST $REDWOOD_API/v1/generate -d '{"model":"kernel-v2.14-q","prompt":"smoke test"}' | jq .
# perf profile
python tools/perf/check_p95.py --model kernel-v2.14-q --samples 50
```
Expectations: p95 latency <120ms on small gen, GPU mem <80%, no new NaNs.

mike: Telemetry thresholds for rollback: error_rate(tokens) > 0.5% for 10m OR p95 latency increase >20% vs baseline for 15m. Also watch top-k distribution drift >0.02 JS divergence for core prompts. If triggers, auto-pin + abort next bucket.

ops-oncall: I'll be on watch during the window. Add me to #release-watch and enable the synthetic monitors for the steam set. Set pager if rollback criteria hit. :eyes:

tina: Recommend regional ordering: eu -> na -> apac to reduce blast radius. Also suggest we run a short A/B on bucket1 with quantized fallback variant (kernel-v2.14-qf) for 15m to compare outputs.

deploybot: Pin request accepted: sticky-pin=2h for legacy-abi on affected routes. Rollout plan updated to include regional ordering and fallback variant sampling. Commands for ops:```text
# to abort next bucket
rbctl abort deploy-4001239876 --bucket 3
# to pin traffic to fallback
rbctl pin route=/generate --to kernel-v2.14-qf --ttl 7200
```

ben: For release note draft: "Engine: kernel v2.14 (quant build) — matmul kernel rewrite for fp4 packing; expected perf +12% p50, small top-k variance in edge prompts. If customers see regression, please contact support with sample prompt + timestamps." Add known caveats about deterministic bump.

sasha: Great. I'll publish the draft to the release-notes doc and handoff runbook in Google Drive, set the release-watch alias, and post a short blurb to #general after successful ramp. Post-deploy checklist: 1) remove sticky-pin, 2) run postbake perf script, 3) close change in Console. :thumbsup:

liam: One more — can someone add a quick smoke sample set to the deploy ticket so we have automated evals post-bucket? I can add 20 prompts.

anya: Added prompts to the ticket and linked the eval harness. Will run final dry-run at 01:15 UTC.

sasha: Perfect. If no objections I'll start the deploy at 02:00 UTC.

mike: No objections from latency/telemetry side. Go ahead. :party_parrot:
